e.category: AI 智能体与保险应用
e.title: Evidence Review（图像证据理赔裁决）
e.summary: AI 理赔裁决 demo（13★，2026）：上传图片+描述→图像证据核验→结构化裁决（支持/矛盾/证据不足），Amazon Nova
e.body: Evidence-Review（jannatul-fredaues，13★）是图像证据驱动的理赔裁决 demo：pick 标的类型、描述理赔、上传照片，AI 对图像证据核验后给出结构化裁决（supported / contradicted / not enough information），FastAPI+前端 case-file 式 UI；源自 hackathon claim-adjudication，接入 Amazon Nova LLM。对 RIAA：图像证据理赔审核的产品原型——与 [[car-damage-assessment-ai]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]（车损检测）互补，体现『证据分级裁决』而非简单分类的理赔 AI 思路。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：图像证据理赔裁决 demo（FastAPI+Amazon Nova，结构化证据分级裁决）
e.title_hk: Evidence Review（圖像證據理賠裁決）
e.summary_en: AI claims-adjudication demo (13★, 2026): upload photos + description → image-evidence check → structured verdict (supported / contradicted / insufficient), Amazon Nova
e.summary_hk: AI 理賠裁決 demo（13★，2026）：上傳圖片+描述→圖像證據核驗→結構化裁決（支持/矛盾/證據不足），Amazon Nova
e.body_en: Evidence-Review (jannatul-fredaues, 13★) is an image-evidence-driven claims-adjudication demo: pick an object type, describe the claim, drop in photos, and the AI checks the image evidence to return a structured verdict (supported / contradicted / not enough information), with a FastAPI backend and case-file styled UI; from a hackathon claim-adjudication build on Amazon Nova LLM. For RIAA: a product prototype for image-evidence claim review — complements [[car-damage-assessment-ai]] and [[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]] (damage detection) and illustrates evidence-graded adjudication rather than plain classification.
e.body_hk: Evidence-Review（jannatul-fredaues，13★）是圖像證據驅動的理賠裁決 demo：pick 標的類型、描述理賠、上傳照片，AI 對圖像證據核驗後給出結構化裁決（supported / contradicted / not enough information），FastAPI+前端 case-file 式 UI；源自 hackathon claim-adjudication，接入 Amazon Nova LLM。對 RIAA：圖像證據理賠審核的產品原型——與 [[car-damage-assessment-ai]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]（車損檢測）互補，體現『證據分級裁決』而非簡單分類的理賠 AI 思路。
